summary.text: Melanie Tompkins is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Donald Ardell.
A social worker born in Presque Isle, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tompkins was born in Presque Isle, Maine, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Presque Isle in 2015 and a graduate degree from the University of Maine in Orono in 2020.
Her career experience includes working as a social worker, and as of 2024 she was affiliated with the National Association of Social Workers.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Tompkins described herself as a mom, county girl and licensed clinical social worker.
Tompkins ran for Maine House District 6 in 2024 and lost the general election to Donald Ardell, 34.5 percent to 65.5 percent.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, with 437 votes.

In the 2024 survey, Tompkins named childcare, schools and housing supply as priorities, and said rural Maine has been disproportionately affected by the substance use epidemic and a lack of mental health services.
